evidence: The precursors used for the depositions were trimethyl indium 98+% (99.9 % In, Strem Chemicals), diethyl zinc (min. 95%, Strem Chemicals) and water (HPLC grade, Sigma-Aldrich). Argon (99.9999 %, Alpha Gaz TM ) was used as a carrier gas, for the depositions and maintained at a constant flow rate of 20 sccm.
